description:
Talk to your Bing Ads data. Tell ChatGPT what to change.

Connect your Microsoft Advertising accounts and ask questions in plain language. Compare spend, clicks, impressions, and conversions across campaigns, keywords, and devices. See what changed between date ranges without exporting a CSV.

Rename your Search campaigns, pause them, and raise or lower their individual daily budgets. Set an exact budget or ask for a percentage change, like “Reduce this campaign’s daily budget by 10%.”

For example, ask “Which campaigns spent more last week but generated fewer conversions?” After reviewing the results, choose a campaign and tell ChatGPT what to change.

Adzviser checks the campaign settings and your account permissions, then shows the current and proposed values. Review and confirm the exact edit before it is applied, and check the result in the same conversation.

Adzviser is an independent service and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

publication.release_notes: Analyze Microsoft Ads performance and manage Search campaigns in the same chat. Preview campaign renames, pauses, and individual daily budget changes, confirm exact edits, check their results, and manage connection write access.

prompts: How much did we spend on Microsoft Ads, and how many impressions and clicks did we get, in August 2026 in Demo?
Show Microsoft Ads spend, impressions, and clicks by campaign for August 2026 in Demo.
How did our Microsoft Ads spend, impressions, and clicks break down by device in August 2026 in Demo?
Compare Microsoft Ads spend, impressions, and clicks in August 2026 with July 2026 in Demo.
Show daily Microsoft Ads spend, impressions, and clicks for August 2026 in Demo.
What can I change in the Microsoft Ads accounts connected to Demo? Show the account names, what is supported, and whether I have write access. Do not prepare or apply anything.
In Demo, preview renaming the paused Microsoft Ads Search campaign Adzviser Review Original to Adzviser Review Renamed. Keep it paused and do not apply the change yet.

positive.description: Overall advertising performance. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to Demo, containing Adzviser LLC - Expert. The campaigns are suspended, so use the fixed historical period August 1–31, 2026; the comparison also uses July 1–31, 2026. These periods were verified to contain activity. Do not recalculate them from the current date. Expected answers must come from live returned rows, not stored numeric answers.
positive.prompt: How much did we spend on Microsoft Ads, and how many impressions and clicks did we get, in August 2026 in Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_bing_ads for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=Demo and only assorted_requests.bing_ads_request. Inspect model-visible reportingData, every returned report table, and note_of_assumption. Use the header row to identify columns and actual returned values for answers. Keep currencies separate; Cost is advertising spend, not a currency-converted value. Do not add duplicated rows from different report tables together. Explain authorization errors, missing access, incomplete coverage, or empty reports rather than converting them into zero activity. Do not invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Cost, Impressions, Clicks], breakdowns=[Currency code], date_ranges=[["2026-08-01", "2026-08-31"]], with no time_granularity. Report totals by currency from the account-level table. State the actual start and end dates. Do not substitute a keyword or campaign subtotal for the account report. Keep the fixed calendar dates specified in the prompt, even if the review occurs later. This historical fixture should return nonempty reporting rows; if it does not, report the access or retrieval problem rather than silently selecting another period.

positive.description: Discover supported Microsoft Ads management tasks without preparing changes. Fresh conversation with only this plugin enabled, an owner OAuth session and access to Demo. Exercise a Read-only Microsoft Ads connection if available; no mutation or access change is authorized.
positive.prompt: What can I change in the Microsoft Ads accounts connected to Demo? Show the account names, what is supported, and whether I have write access. Do not prepare or apply anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Demo and call get_resources with workspace_name Demo and source bing_ads, with no resource_type or refs. Read access with get_data_source_access using workspace_name Demo only, and match the returned scopes to the Microsoft Ads connections. Present returned capabilities, account names and IDs, can_write, writes_enabled and restrictions. Keep grouped advertisers identifiable and show supported options for Read-only accounts. Do not display or manage other providers, prepare previews, change access, apply anything, or fetch a performance report for this overview.

positive.description: Preview an account edit without applying it. Use a dedicated Microsoft Ads test advertiser connected to Demo with writing enabled and one paused Search campaign named Adzviser Review Original. Exclude experiments and their base campaigns. This fixture and provider access must be verified before running; if unavailable, report the setup gap. If multiple advertisers match, ask the reviewer to select one before preparing the preview.
positive.prompt: In Demo, preview renaming the paused Microsoft Ads Search campaign Adzviser Review Original to Adzviser Review Renamed. Keep it paused and do not apply the change yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover source bing_ads and resolve the connection scope_ref and advertiser account_id. Inspect the campaign, its Search campaign type, current paused status, resource_ref, actions and action_schemas. Call preview_changes with workspace_name Demo and one rename action using only the discovered target resource_ref and new name. Display the saved preview's account identity and before/after name, preserving paused status and all unrelated settings. Retain its change_id and digest. Do not call apply_changes or change permissions. Explain that this preview validates locally against current settings; Microsoft validates the update when applied. Do not imply that Microsoft has accepted the proposed update yet.

positive.description: Apply and verify an exactly confirmed saved preview. Continue the preceding rename case in the same conversation after its account, resource, and before/after effects have been displayed. Use only the dedicated paused Search test campaign. After verification, restore its original name with a separate preview and reviewer confirmation; never restore automatically.
positive.prompt: I confirm the exact rename preview you just showed. Apply that saved change and check the result. Keep the campaign paused.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the change_id and digest from the displayed, confirmed preview unchanged. Do not prepare a duplicate preview or broaden the target. Call get_change_result for the same change and report write_status, verification_status and observed values. If running, follow the receipt's retry interval with bounded checks. If the outcome is uncertain, inspect the same receipt and do not create a replacement change. Claim success only to the extent supported by the receipt; do not report a paused-state change or modify the budget.

positive.description: Prepare a connection-permission change and honor the approval boundary. Use a dedicated test connection in Demo that the reviewer can identify, with Read and write currently enabled. No advertiser edit is requested. If there are multiple matches, ask the reviewer to choose the connection and show all grouped advertisers before preparation.
positive.prompt: In Demo, prepare switching my Microsoft Ads connection from Read and write to Read-only. Show every account affected, but do not apply it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover Microsoft Ads connections with get_resources using workspace_name Demo and source bing_ads. Read current access with get_data_source_access using workspace_name Demo only, and match the requested Microsoft Ads scope_ref. Preserve its returned expected_revision. Call set_data_source_access with workspace_name Demo, that scope_ref, can_write false and the exact revision. Display the existing and requested permission and all advertiser names and IDs in the selected connection. Retain the returned change_id and digest. Do not call apply_changes, change other connections, or prepare campaign edits. Explain if the connection is already Read-only rather than claiming a new permission was applied.

negative.prompt: Resume every paused Microsoft Ads campaign.
negative.description: Microsoft Ads campaign enabling is not currently available through this connector. Explain that it can pause eligible Search campaigns but cannot resume them. Do not invent an ENABLED action, call a reporting tool as a substitute, enable connection write access, prepare a pause instead, or claim that delivery resumed.

negative.prompt: Add the keyword affordable running shoes to my Microsoft Ads campaign.
negative.description: Microsoft Ads keyword creation is not currently available through this connector. Explain that it can report on keywords, while account edits are limited to eligible Search campaign renames, pauses, and individual daily budgets. Do not borrow Google Ads actions, fabricate a keyword resource, fetch an unsolicited report, or claim the keyword was added.

negative.prompt: Give me the names and email addresses of the people who clicked our Microsoft Ads last week.
negative.description: Unsupported identification of individual ad clickers. Explain that this reporting plugin does not provide those identities. Do not infer identities, invent personal information, or request unrelated reports.

review.commerce_description: Adzviser subscriptions are purchased separately on the Adzviser website. This plugin does not offer in-plugin purchases or checkout. Confirmed campaign budget changes can affect advertising spend in the connected Microsoft Advertising account. Previewing an edit or preparing a connection-permission change does not apply it.
